triggers.sql:
CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` TRIGGER `trg_tb_order_cancellations_after_update` AFTER UPDATE ON `tb_order_cancellations` FOR EACH ROW BEGIN
    DECLARE v_cambios TEXT;
    SET v_cambios = CONCAT_WS('',
        IF(NOT (OLD.`order_ID` <=> NEW.`order_ID`), CONCAT('[order_ID: ', COALESCE(CAST(OLD.`order_ID` AS CHAR), 'NULL'), ' -> ', COALESCE(CAST(NEW.`order_ID` AS CHAR), 'NULL'), '] '), NULL),

procedures.name: sp_register_user_with_person
procedures.sql:
CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` PROCEDURE `sp_register_user_with_person`(
    -- Parámetros para tb_users
    IN p_email VARCHAR(80),
    IN p_nickname VARCHAR(100),
    IN p_password VARCHAR(255),
    
    -- Parámetros para tb_people
    IN p_courtesy_title VARCHAR(20),
    IN p_given_names VARCHAR(150),
    IN p_family_names VARCHAR(150),
    IN p_birth_date DATE,
    IN p_gender_id TINYINT UNSIGNED,
    IN p_country_code CHAR(2),
    IN p_phone VARCHAR(25)
)
BEGIN
    DECLARE v_user_id INT;

    -- Manejador de excepciones: si ocurre un error, deshace los cambios (ROLLBACK)
    DECLARE EXIT HANDLER FOR SQLEXCEPTION
    BEGIN
        ROLLBACK;
        RESIGNAL;
    END;

    -- Inicio de la transacción atómica
    START TRANSACTION;

    -- 1. Registro en tb_users
    INSERT INTO tb_users (
        email, 
        nickname, 
        password
    )
    VALUES (
        p_email, 
        p_nickname, 
        p_password
    );

    -- Captura del ID autogenerado en tb_users
    SET v_user_id = LAST_INSERT_ID();

    -- 2. Registro en tb_people vinculando el user_ID obtenido
    INSERT INTO tb_people (
        user_ID,
        courtesy_title,
        given_names,
        family_names,
        birth_date,
        gender_ID,
        country_code,
        phone
    )
    VALUES (
        v_user_id,
        p_courtesy_title,
        p_given_names,
        p_family_names,
        p_birth_date,
        p_gender_id,
        p_country_code,
        p_phone
    );

    -- Confirmación de los datos en ambas tablas
    COMMIT;
END ;;

CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` FUNCTION `fn_country_is_supported`(p_country CHAR(2)) RETURNS tinyint
    READS SQL DATA
BEGIN
    RETURN (
        EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tbc_gen_given_names
                 WHERE country_code = p_country AND gender = 'H' AND status = b'1')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tbc_gen_given_names
                 WHERE country_code = p_country AND gender = 'M' AND status = b'1')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tbc_gen_family_names
                 WHERE country_code = p_country AND status = b'1')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tbc_gen_email_domains
                 WHERE country_code = p_country AND status = b'1')
        AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tbc_gen_phone_area_codes
                 WHERE country_code = p_country AND status = b'1')
    );
END ;;
